test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom from the options given below:

A square peg in a round hole

options.text: a person who is criminal by nature
a person who fits the job
a person who does not fit the job

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **a person who does not fit the job**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A square peg in a round hole"** refers to a person who is unsuited for the position or situation they are placed in. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो किसी कार्य या स्थिति के लिए अनुपयुक्त हो।)

 
 
• **Example:** John is a square peg in a round hole in his current job; he lacks the skills required for this role.
 
 
 
• **Correct Meaning:** A person who does not fit the job. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो काम के लिए उपयुक्त न हो।)
 
 
• **Example:** Hiring Sarah for this technical role was a mistake; she is a square peg in a round hole here.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A person who is criminal by nature** (स्वभाव से अपराधी व्यक्ति): Refers to someone with a tendency to commit crimes.

 
 
• **Example:** His repeated offenses show that he is criminal by nature.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A person who fits the job** (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो काम के लिए उपयुक्त हो): Refers to someone whose skills and abilities are perfectly suited for the role.
 
 
• **Example:** Jane is the perfect candidate for this role; she fits the job like a glove.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A person who is bankrupt** (दिवालिया व्यक्ति): Refers to someone who is financially insolvent or without money.
 
 
• **Example:** After his business failed, he was declared bankrupt.
 
 

117:Tb32,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
